explanation: The eternal Word who was with God from the beginning and is himself God, later incarnated as Jesus Christ.
Light and life-giving power that came through the Word and gives people the ability to know God.
The truth and presence of God shining in the darkness; it cannot be extinguished by evil or ignorance.
A person, often John the Baptist, who confirms the truth about Jesus to others through their words and actions.
Term for those who believe in Jesus' name and receive the right to become children of God by his grace.
